constraints: Keep the variable name and its value unchanged.
Use one key=value assignment per variable.

steps.instructions: Replace ENV key value with ENV key="value", quoting the value when it contains spaces.
steps.title: Write the variable as key=value

verification.purpose: Build the image with the rewritten Dockerfile.
Confirm the variable keeps its name and value.

rules.replacement: The ENV key=value form, with the value quoted when it contains spaces
rules.summary: Docker's LegacyKeyValueFormat build check flags the space-separated ENV form and recommends writing each assignment as key=value.
rules.title: The Dockerfile legacy "ENV key value" form is deprecated

constraints: Keep the author text exactly as it is written.
Quote the label value so spaces and punctuation stay part of the value.

steps.instructions: Replace the MAINTAINER instruction with LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors, using the same author text as a quoted value.
steps.title: Replace MAINTAINER with the OCI author label

verification.purpose: Build the image with the rewritten Dockerfile.
Confirm the image carries the org.opencontainers.image.authors label.

rules.replacement: A LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors instruction carrying the same author text
rules.summary: The Dockerfile reference marks MAINTAINER as deprecated because author metadata belongs in the org.opencontainers.image.authors label.
rules.title: The Dockerfile MAINTAINER instruction is deprecated
